title: Fifth-Force Constraints from UV-Complete Scalar-Tensor Gravity
summary: We study an $O(N)$ scalar multiplet nonminimally coupled to gravity and follow its renormalization-group (RG) flow in the vicinity of an interacting, nonperturbatively UV-complete scaling regime of scalar-tensor theory. In the broken phase, the radial mode mediates a universal Yukawa correction to Newtonian gravity, parametrized by a strength $α$ and range $λ$. Imposing UV completeness -- regular RG trajectories that reach the UV scaling regime -- restricts the infrared data to a finite wedge, which maps to a narrow region in the $(α,λ)$ plane.
